known_cipher_parameters.notes: Solution-bearing calibration parameters for known transform replay. Do not expose these in blind or standard agent context.

benchmark_capability.routing_caveat: Recovery is demonstrated once the case reaches the pure-transposition route. A fully unknown-cipher run must still infer or adopt that family before invoking the capable search.
benchmark_capability.ground_truth_firewall: The TransMatrix parameters and plaintext are solution-bearing calibration data. They may be used for replay and post-hoc grading, but not to generate, rank, route, or select candidates in a blind-search evaluation. The verified blind run selected an equivalent parameterization different from the stored replay parameters.
